name: ClearClef
description: Archive finding-aid score catalog; notation stays ink on white paper.

display.usage: title page, page headings, score-detail title, wordmark; 30px and above only
display.cjkFallback: Songti SC / SimSun / Noto Serif CJK SC for CJK work titles

text.usage: row titles, credit headings, running heads, extents, shelf marks, colophon
text.features: real smcp/c2sc for small capitals; old-style figures for counts; dlig for titles
text.load: next/font/local, app/fonts/*.woff2, Latin subset, variable weight 400-600

metadata.usage: technical strings only: ids, byte sizes, page counters, admin metadata

material.paper: surface-paper: fibre flecks over fine grain, laid and chain lines, top key light, edge vignette
material.board: surface-board: pore over a low-frequency dye blotch, wear at the ends, raking sheen, diagonal falloff
material.on-board: on-board: remaps ink/muted/hairline/focus tokens to board values
material.leaf: surface-leaf + shadow-leaf: paper card with fine grain and four warm corners, plus a warm lifted shadow
material.seam: rule-tooled: blind-tooled groove with light catch below
material.printedRule: rule-printed: strong hairline with a light catch below, on leaves
material.inkedRule: rule-inked: speckle over rust with a dark bed below and a light catch above
material.endpaper: surface-marbled + MarbledPanel: turbulence-displaced stroke marbling, veins via marble-v1..v5; empty catalog and 404 only
material.tokens: --grain-fine, --flecks, --pore, --blotch: one inline SVG turbulence recipe per material, swappable for a scanned tile
